about_the_game:
Surviving on the streets isn’t easy...
Some days you’ll chase a hot meal, other days you’ll survive on a dry cardboard.
You’ve got nothing no home, no job, no guarantees. But this city can be your playground!
Make money through recycling, beg from people, push boundaries, even steal.
Feed yourself, stay clean, and maybe try your luck in an arcade.
Plan your days, find shelter at night.
Survival here is not just physical it’s a mental challenge.
How far can you go in this fight to survive?

🕒 24 Hour Day Cycle & A Large Map to Explore

This city reveals a new face every hour. Start working in the morning, find a safe spot at night.
Manage your time well money is always needed to survive in this sprawling city!

♻️ Recycling System

Trash isn’t just waste it’s survival.
Gather bottles, cans, scrap, and sell them at recycling centers to earn money.

🤲 Begging Mechanic

Sometimes asking for help is your only option. Approach people and ask for cash or food.
Be warned not everyone here is kind. Some will ignore you, others may demand more.

🕶️ Theft System

Seems unethical? Maybe. But the streets are ruthless.
Be cunning and discreet a wallet or some food could keep you going another day.
But if you're caught, the police won’t show mercy.

🧼 Pollution & Cleanliness

Street life gets you dirty. People judge by appearance.
Staying clean improves social interactions. Public restrooms, fountains, and opportunities await.

🎰 Arcades & Casino

Survival isn’t only physical it’s mental too.
Unwind in city arcades with mini games. Maybe fortune will favor you.
Are you willing to take the risk?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD R9 270X
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 7600K / Ryzen 5 2600x
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or higher
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: Start from nothing. Scavenge, beg, steal, or hustle your way through the harsh streets of the city. Earn money, manage your hunger, face tough choices, and rise from the cold pavement to reclaim your place in society. Will you survive with dignity or lose yourself in the struggle?
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
